name: 幻想乡夜绘
scope: Artwork only; no item, shop, lottery or Addressables configuration changes.
theme: Companion to 幻想乡绘札: indigo shrine landscape, champagne-gold thin frame, sakura and yin-yang accents.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished game player namecard background, landscape EXACT 8:3, 2048x768. Reference image is ONLY palette and Touhou Gensokyo ornamental identity, NOT composition. Match its deep indigo and champagne-gold printed illustration aesthetic. Full opaque dark blue illustrated background, extremely subtle broad silhouettes of distant shrine torii and misty hills in center, muted indigo 12-25% brightness, no light hotspots. A fine elegant rounded gold hairline border follows outer edges. Tiny cherry blossoms and paper talisman motifs tucked into corners, a TINY yin-yang roundel embedded in top border. ALL bright gold/ivory marks and ornaments confined within outer 48 pixels (maximum64) of closest edge. Spacious quiet dark center will hold game player text: absolutely no central medallion, foreground people, text, UI, letters, numbers, writing, guides. Soft drawn linework and restrained flat shading, delicate Japanese fantasy illustration matching Touhou-themed deck. Do not copy dense cardback design. Card fills entire canvas front-on, no perspective, no outer mockup background, no cast shadow. Central scenery present but very low contrast; highest detail only thin perimeter. No wide blank black hole; rich indigo atmosphere.
